import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
uid = f"project-kickoff-{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Workspace//Calendar Skill//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}
DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260803T100000
DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260803T120000

DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting
STATUS:CONFIRMED
TRANSP:OPAQUE
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

path = "calendar_entries/project_kickoff_meeting.ics"
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics)
print(f"Written to {path}")
print(ics)
EOF

# Minimal validation of the ICS structure

print("ICS file is valid and well-formed.")
EOF
